device_label: 8 um radius ITiO-gated MOSCAP MRM, accumulation mode (measured)

notes: Version: all values from arXiv 2308.16255v1 (21 pp incl. Supplementary Information), not the Nature Communications version of record. Heterogeneous Si ring (Intel 300 mm SOI photonics fab, passive ring) with a post-processed HfO2/ITiO gate stack on 62.5 percent of the ring (Oregon State University). Operating point: 3 dB IL at -1.5 V, bias -1.9 V, swing -1.5 to -2.3 V (0.8 Vpp). Static ER 6 dB is read on the transmission-vs-gate-voltage curve within that swing, not from eye diagrams. Tuning efficiency 117 pm/V applies in accumulation mode (beyond -1.5 V); 87 pm/V in depletion mode (0 to -1.5 V). Vpi*L 0.12 V cm is a resonance-shift figure (formula not given; FSR not stated, so not re-derived). 3 dB bandwidth 11 GHz includes optical peaking, referenced to 500 MHz, RC-limited by 500 fF total capacitance; the text states the photon-lifetime limit as 50 GHz (Q 4600). Capacitance 333 fF is the authors' total (500 fF) minus the slab contribution; leakage 495 pA at -1.9 V (SI). Energy 53 fJ/bit is the authors' C*V^2/4 with 333 fF and 0.8 Vpp (checks to 53.3). 25 Gb/s open eye at 0.8 Vpp without pre-emphasis; 35 Gb/s open eyes need 1.75 Vpp and AWG pre-emphasis from the S21 data. Passive ring Q about 20000 near critical coupling (design target in text). Simulated values (Q 5000, 125 pm/V, 7.6 dB ER) are not entered. [34]; bias and definition not given; the value is not tied to the -0.9 V / 1312 nm operating point, basis author_estimate, qualifier approx because 'as high as' gives no clear bound direction. substrate: silicon-on-insulator (Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation CMOS process)

modulation_format: OOK, no DSP; open eyes 30 GBd (EF 0), 60 GBd (EF 0.36), 80 GBd (EF 0.61), 90 GBd (EF 0.75)
driver: SHF S804B 60 GHz amplifier, 40 GHz power splitter with electrical attenuator (sets EF), SHF C603B 2:1 multiplexer; GSGSG probe; external 50 ohm loads
notes: Version: all values from arXiv 2312.14537v1 (19 pp), no journal DOI; no Crossref record. Dual-drive MZM whose two carrier-depletion phase shifters are set to different bandwidths by bias; the equalization factor EF is the low-speed to high-speed drive amplitude ratio. Open-eye OOK baud rate without DSP rises with EF: 30 GBd at EF 0 (ER 3.59 dB), 60 at 0.36, 80 at 0.61, 90 at 0.75 (Fig. 6; ER 2.29 dB at 90 GBd for EF 0.75). Drive: 3.6 Vpp on the high-speed shifter at 6 V bias; low-speed shifter 1.3, 2.2, 2.7 Vpp at EF 0.36, 0.61, 0.75, bias kept below 4 V. 50 um arm path-length difference lets the carrier wavelength set the operating point. Relation to yue2025 (2410.09816, tunable time-frequency equalization, over 110 GHz, 140 GBd): related technique from the same group but a different, later paper with different devices and numbers; yue2023 is not cited in the cached yue2025 PDF. Numbers are kept separate. Step-response simulations (Figs. 2-3, assumed 60/20 GHz phase-shifter bandwidths) are illustrative and not entered. Not reported: Vpi, EO S21, wavelength, doping levels, optical power.

notes: Version: arXiv 2312.14537v1. Not reported: Vpi, EO S21, wavelength, doping levels, optical power.
